policy: product/architecture.md section 2 + section 10; each writable table has exactly one fact owner; runtime writes only from that owner's adapter

notes.model_calls: per-domain visible usage facts (collaboration/execution/review) follow the domain owner per section-2 'visible usage facts' clauses, not the Runtime session-log capability (CAP-RUN-02+, unimplemented)
notes.review_memory: review_memory_candidates/associations are memory-domain facts (actor/source/version per A-64/A-65) owned by knowledge-provenance; since T-07 memory_entries/review_memory_associations writers sit in src/adapters/outbound/sqlite/knowledge-provenance/ (memory-service.ts, memory-committer.ts); review_memory_candidates is still written inline by review/review-finalizer.ts under a transitional exemption — formalized in T-11/T-13
notes.execution_approvals: Approval requests/rulings owned by governance per section-2; currently physically inside execution/ — extracted in T-08
notes.sequences: collaboration_*_sequences counters are collaboration-internal identity infrastructure
notes.audit_projection: feature 028: safe-execution appends audit_event_outbox rows atomically with execution_events; audit_event_projection/audit_projection_checkpoints belong to the operations-projection consumer (T-02), registered now with the audit-projection-store anchor writer
notes.audit_outbox_shared_append: feature 030: audit_event_outbox is a multi-source append seam — each source owner appends its own rows atomically inside its business transaction (safe-execution since 028, public-collaboration since 030); fact ownership of the table stays with safe-execution, additional source writers are registered in sharedAppendWriters
notes.thread_search_index: feature 031: derived search projection (thread titles + persisted public message bodies) owned by the operations-projection consumer (thread-search-index); no FKs by design (A-140 projection semantics), index⊆fact-source enforced by reopen data invariants
notes.thread_tags: feature 032: project-scoped thread tag facts (thread_tags), assignment edges (thread_tag_edges), and versioned batch receipts (thread_tag_operations) owned by public-collaboration; tag delete clears edges explicitly in the same transaction (FK CASCADE is only the thread-cascade backstop), edges⊆threads/tags enforced by reopen data invariants; the T-03 batch command writes receipts through the insertThreadTagOperationReceiptTx anchor registered in thread-tag-service.ts
notes.thread_purge_markers: feature 033: transaction-local purge exemption markers (inserted at purge start, deleted before commit) owned by public-collaboration; no FK to collaboration_threads by design (the row is about to disappear), projects CASCADE is the only lifecycle backstop, empty-table enforced by reopen data invariants
